description: This file is a PHPUnit test case class for testing the CandidateMarkingInterviewPassAPI in the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It contains test methods for API endpoints such as getOne, getValidationRuleForGetOne, update, delete, and getValidationRuleForDelete, focusing on the CandidateMarkingInterviewPassAPI functionality. The class sets up test data, mocks dependencies, and verifies behaviors related to candidate interview marking operations.
